description: Helena, MT — […] One other candidate filed with the Secretary of State this week – but he’s not yet guaranteed a spot on the ballot. Mike Eisenhauer, a cardiologist from Great Falls, is running as an independent. He needs to gather at least 7,274 signatures from registered voters by May, in order to qualify […]
title: Growing list of challengers to face U.S. Rep. Downing - Eisenhauer for Congress
